name: gradual-rollout
title: Gradual rollout
description: In isometric ink: a feature flag's console moves a new version from 10% to 100% of traffic; the new server hops and lights up as its share jumps, the router presses, the old server sinks, and packets on light rails shift across. Objects move as solids; leans with the pointer; in your theme.

useCases: Feature flag and experimentation product sites
Edge and hosting platforms explaining safe releases
Canary and progressive delivery feature sections
Developer tools landing pages about shipping safely
